description: MowoBuildTool — Custom build system for MowoEngine

globalOptions.name: --dry-run
globalOptions.description: Show what would be done without executing

commands.name: asset
commands.description: Inspect asset packages (any asset or level file) and migrate text assets into them

subcommands.name: diff
subcommands.description: Property-level diff of two MDF documents or asset packages

subcommands.name: dump
subcommands.description: Print an asset package as text (the git textconv for the binary asset types)

subcommands.name: merge
subcommands.description: Three-way property merge of MDF documents; the result replaces <ours>

arguments.name: ours
arguments.description: Our version, overwritten with the merge (git %A)

options.name: --visual-script
options.description: The files are Visual Script graphs or classes (.vscript): merge by node id

subcommands.name: migrate
subcommands.description: Convert a project's text assets into packages under their own extensions (.mmap + __ExternalActors__ for levels); a mesh package's .mmeshmeta/.manimmeta settings move into its payload

options.name: --report-only
options.description: Report what would change and write nothing

options.name: --source-art
options.description: Move texture and model sources from Content/ to SourceArt/ and import them as binary packages (.tex, .mesh, .skmesh, ...)

subcommands.name: primary
subcommands.description: List a project's primary assets, their chunks and cook rules

options.name: --write-chunks
options.description: Regenerate Config/Chunks.ini from the primary asset rules

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build engine modules

options.name: --target
options.description: Build specific target module

options.name: --config
options.description: Build configuration: debug | dev | profile | release | debuggame (default: dev)

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform: win-x64 | linux-x64 | osx-arm64 | android-arm64 | ios-arm64 (default: host). Non-host targets cross-compile — set MOWO_LINUX_SYSROOT / SDKROOT / ANDROID_NDK_ROOT; ios needs a macOS host with Xcode.

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Max parallel compile jobs

options.name: --shared-cache
options.description: Team object cache: a shared directory or an S3-compatible https:// bucket (also MBT_SHARED_CACHE). Objects are pulled before compiling and pushed after

options.name: --shared-cache-read-only
options.description: Pull from the shared cache but never push to it (also MBT_SHARED_CACHE_PUSH=0)

options.name: --hot-reload
options.description: Link the -t module to a versioned output (<name>.v<N>.dll) for live coding

options.name: --extra-source
options.description: Additional directory to scan for *.Build.cs modules (game project Source/)

options.name: --option
options.description: Custom build option KEY=VALUE for the rules (e.g. -o MOWO_ENABLE_FSR=true)

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove build artifacts

options.name: --all
options.description: Also remove intermediate caches

commands.name: cook
commands.description: Cook and pack assets into MEAF archives

options.name: --assets
options.description: Asset source directory (default: Content/)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .meaf path

options.name: --compression
options.description: Compression level (None, Fast, Default, Best)

options.name: --force
options.description: Force recook all assets

options.name: --meaf-builder
options.description: Path to meaf_builder executable

options.name: --meaf-encrypt-key
options.description: Hex key file (32 bytes) — encrypt archive TOCs + payloads (see `MeafBuilder keygen`)

options.name: --meaf-key-id
options.description: Encryption key id stored in the archive header

options.name: --meaf-sign-key
options.description: Hex secret key file (64 bytes) — sign the archives

options.name: --scenes
options.description: Comma-separated entry level (.mmap) paths — cook only what they reference

options.name: --raw-assets
options.description: Pack texture (PNG/JPG/BMP/TGA) and mesh (FBX/glTF/OBJ/DAE) sources as-is instead of cooking them to .mtex/.mmodel

options.name: --mdf-text
options.description: Pack MDF game data as raw text instead of mdfb binary (debug fallback)

options.name: --astc
options.description: Cook LDR textures to ASTC 6x6 (mobile GPUs have no BC) instead of BC7/BC5

options.name: --platform
options.description: Cook for a target platform: win-x64 | linux-x64 | osx-arm64 | android-arm64 | ios-arm64. A mobile target cooks ASTC textures and Opus audio; the target's Shaders.meaf is built beside the archive; the default output goes to <cook dir>/<Platform>/. Default: the host, into <cook dir>/ as before

options.name: --audio-codec
options.description: Cook every clip to this codec over its import settings: pcm16 | pcm24 | float | opus. Default: opus for a mobile --platform, else each clip's own

options.name: --no-shaders
options.description: With --platform, skip building the target's Shaders.meaf beside the archive

options.name: --strict-refs
options.description: Fail the cook when a scene/material/prefab reference cannot be resolved to a file

options.name: --allow-raw
options.description: Pack texture/mesh sources raw when their transcode cannot run (MowoGame missing or the batch failed) instead of failing the cook

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip the asset-validation gate (MowoGame --validate-assets)

options.name: --config
options.description: Build of MowoGame/MeafBuilder/MdfTool/MaudioTool the cook runs (default: dev, then debug): debug | dev | profile | release | debuggame

commands.name: crypto

options.name: --project

options.name: --encryption

options.name: --signing

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace keys that already exist. A build made with a new key cannot open archives an older build shipped — patches and DLC included

subcommands.name: import-signing-key
subcommands.description: Put the signing private key of the project's public key into this user's key store (a new machine, a teammate)

options.name: --project
options.description: Game project manifest (.mproject)

options.name: --file
options.description: A file holding the 128-hex-digit private key (a key-store file, or MeafBuilder's meaf_signing.key)

subcommands.description: Move a signing private key committed in Config/DefaultCrypto.ini (the layout before 2026-10-13) to this user's key store and rewrite the file without it

options.name: --project
options.description: Game project manifest (.mproject)

subcommands.name: show

options.name: --project
options.description: Game project manifest (.mproject)

commands.name: package
commands.description: Full build + cook + package for distribution

options.name: --config
options.description: Build configuration: debug | dev | profile | release | debuggame (default: release)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform for the build step: win64 | linux | macos-arm64 (default: host). Cross packaging of installers/signing stays a Windows-host concern.

options.name: --icon
options.description: Application icon (.ico / .png)

options.name: --name
options.description: Product name (default: project directory name)

options.name: --skip-build
options.description: Skip C++ build (use existing binaries)

options.name: --skip-shaders
options.description: Skip shader compilation

options.name: --monolithic
options.description: Link the engine statically into the game host (UE5 Shipping model); the package ships one exe + vendor DLLs. The default for a release Game package

options.name: --modular
options.description: Ship the engine as per-module DLLs even in release (the default for every other configuration)

options.name: --unprotected
options.description: Ship plaintext, unsigned content and unsigned modules even when Config/DefaultCrypto.ini has keys. Release otherwise refuses to package without them.

options.name: --crypto-config
options.description: A crypto INI outside the project to package with instead of its Config/DefaultCrypto.ini; it may hold the signing private key inline (the test rows' throwaway keys)

options.name: --target
options.description: Build target to package: Game (branded player) or Server (headless dedicated server — GPU-free module flavor, no shaders, exe branded <Product>Server)

options.name: --project
options.description: Game project manifest (.mproject) to package. Default: the manifest at the build root, if there is exactly one.

options.name: --mdf-text
options.description: Pack MDF game data as raw text instead of mdfb binary (debug fallback)

options.name: --raw-assets
options.description: Pack texture (PNG/JPG/BMP/TGA) and mesh (FBX/glTF/OBJ/DAE) sources as-is instead of cooking them to .mtex/.mmodel

options.name: --compression
options.description: Compression of the content archives (None, Fast, Default, Best)

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip the asset-validation gate `mbt cook` also runs (MowoGame --validate-assets)

options.name: --strict-refs
options.description: Fail the package on an unresolvable asset reference or a failed texture/mesh cook

options.name: --allow-raw
options.description: Pack texture/mesh sources raw when their transcode cannot run instead of failing the package

options.name: --zip
options.description: Produce a distributable <Product>-<version>-<config>.zip of the package

options.name: --full-crt
options.description: Bundle the complete VC++ redist folder instead of the three essential CRT DLLs

options.name: --no-vc-redist
options.description: Win64: leave out the VC++ redist fallback (installscript.vdf + _CommonRedist/vcredist/2022/VC_redist.x64.exe); Config/Packaging.ini vcRedist=false does the same

options.name: --vc-redist-exe
options.description: Win64: the VC_redist.x64.exe to ship as the fallback (default: Config/Packaging.ini vcRedistInstaller, else the one beside the toolchain's CRT redist)

options.name: --installer
options.description: Emit an installer: on Windows a WiX .msi (candle/light on PATH, else a self-extracting PowerShell installer); on macOS a .dmg with a self-contained ad-hoc-signed .app

options.name: --sign
options.description: Code-sign the shipped exe + first-party DLLs with this cert (.pfx path, store subject, or SHA1 thumbprint). Falls back to the MOWO_SIGN_CERT env var.

options.name: --drm-wrap
options.description: Wrap the shipped host exe with Steam DRM through steamcmd. Opt-in: the wrapped exe refuses to run outside Steam, which is how the package is normally smoke-tested.

options.name: --steam-user
options.description: Steam account name for --drm-wrap. Falls back to MOWO_STEAM_USER. The password is never a flag; log in once with `steamcmd +login <user>` so it is cached.

options.name: --analytics-endpoint
options.description: Analytics event-send endpoint baked into the shipping manifest (opt-in seam; empty = analytics disabled)

options.name: --no-crash-reporter
options.description: Do not enable the shipping crash reporter in the shipping manifest

options.name: --no-symbols
options.description: Do not upload debug symbols (PDBs) to the Sentry crash server

options.name: --crash-dsn
options.description: Crash-report DSN baked into the shipping manifest (default: Config/Engine.ini [CrashReportClient] Dsn, else the .mproject crashReporter.dsn, else the MowoEngine Sentry project)

options.name: --dlc
options.description: Package ONLY the named DLC plugin (a Plugins/<Name> with "dlc": true) against an existing base package

options.name: --base
options.description: Base package directory the DLC is built against (default: the package output directory)

options.name: --log-floor
options.description: Release only: compile out every log line below this level (info | warning | error), format strings included. Default keeps Info so a packaged build can still be judged with --log --loglevel=info

options.name: --pgo
options.description: Profile-guided optimisation for release/profile (clang): instrument = build binaries that write raw profiles to build/PGO/<Platform>/Raw when run, optimize = merge them into Engine/Build/PGO/<Platform>/Engine.profdata and compile with it

options.name: --promote-open-order
options.description: Copy this machine's Saved/OpenOrder/OpenOrder.txt (recorded by `MowoGame --record-open-order`) over the committed Config/OpenOrder.txt before packaging: the paks then lay entries out in the order a play session first read them. Commit the result.

options.name: --promote-pso-cache
options.description: Copy this machine's Saved/PsoCache/PsoCache.mdfb recording over the committed Config/PsoCache.mdfb before packaging. Commit the result — it is what every build ships.

options.name: --gather-pso
options.description: Before packaging, run MowoGame --gather-pso over the project: every material's pipeline variants (static, skinned, instanced, meshlet, shadow, velocity, forward) merge into the committed Config/PsoCache.mdfb, so coverage follows the content rather than what a recording session played. Needs a non-release MowoGame build and a GPU. Commit the result.

options.name: --iostore
options.description: Convert every staged pak into an IoStore container (.mutoc table of contents + .mucas blocks) with MowoIoStore: on-demand block reads, and unchanged content keeps byte-identical blocks across builds. Config/Packaging.ini `ioStore=true` turns it on for the project.

commands.name: shaders
commands.description: Compile HLSL shaders to SPIR-V and pack declared archives

options.name: --shader-dir
options.description: Manual mode: compile this directory instead of module-declared ones

options.name: --output
options.description: Manual mode: SPIR-V output directory

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration whose binaries folder receives packed archives: debug | dev | profile | release | debuggame (default: dev)

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform: win64 | linux | macos-arm64 | android | ios (default: host). macOS/iOS additionally lower SPIR-V to Metal via spirv-cross; android is Vulkan-only (M0.1).

options.name: --project
options.description: Also compile the project's material-graph shaders (.material.hlsl sidecars under its Content/) into the shader archive

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch for changes and recompile

options.name: --force
options.description: Force recompile all shaders

options.name: --validate
options.description: Only validate shaders (no output)

options.name: --check
options.description: With --report-matrix: fail when a non-excluded job stops compiling, or when the committed Engine/Documentation/ShaderCoverageMatrix.md has drifted from the freshly generated one

options.name: --report-matrix
options.description: Dry-run every variant×stage against the DXIL/DXBC/MSL toolchains and write a coverage + layout report under build/ShaderMatrix/

options.name: --targets
options.description: Comma-separated backend blob targets: spirv,dxil,dxbc,msl (default: spirv, or the per-platform set when --platform is given: win64=spirv,dxil,dxbc; linux=spirv; macos-arm64=spirv,msl). Extra targets pack alongside the SPIR-V plus ShaderManifest.json and per-shader bindmaps.

options.name: --metallib
options.description: macOS host only: compile the .metal outputs to .metallib via xcrun before packing (implies the msl target)

options.name: --workers
options.description: Compile SPIR-V and DXIL stages on N ShaderCompileWorker processes (a number or 'auto'); same as MOWO_SHADER_WORKERS

options.name: --ddc
options.description: Reuse compiled blobs from a shader DDC keyed by source closure, defines, target and compiler: a folder, or '1' for build/ShaderDDC; same as MOWO_SHADER_DDC

commands.name: steam-upload
commands.description: Upload an existing `mbt package` output to Steam (writes the steamcmd build scripts, then runs steamcmd)

options.name: --package
options.description: Packaged game directory to upload (default: Saved/Packaged/<Product>)

options.name: --project
options.description: Game project manifest (.mproject). Default: the manifest at the build root, if there is exactly one.

options.name: --name
options.description: Product name used to locate the package (default: the manifest's build.outputName)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: Steam app id (default: the manifest's platform.steamAppId)

options.name: --depot-id
options.description: Depot id receiving the content (default: the manifest's platform.steamDepots entry, else app id + 1/2/3 for Win64/Mac/Linux)

options.name: --platform
options.description: Platform the package was built for: win64 | linux | macos-arm64 (default: host). Picks the default depot and the package sub-name.

options.name: --depot
options.description: Add a platform to this build as <platform>=<packageDir>, repeatable (e.g. --depot win64=out/Win --depot macos-arm64=out/Mac). Replaces --platform/--package.

options.name: --username
options.description: Steam build account. Default: MOWO_STEAM_USER. The password is never taken here — log in once with `steamcmd +login <user>` so it caches credentials.

options.name: --description
options.description: Build description shown in the Steamworks build history

options.name: --branch
options.description: Beta branch to set live on success (default: none — the build uploads and stays unset)

options.name: --preview
options.description: Steam preview build: steamcmd scans the content and logs what it would do, uploading nothing

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Write the app/depot VDFs and stop — steamcmd is never invoked

options.name: --out
options.description: Directory for the generated VDFs and steamcmd build output (default: build/Steam/<Product>-<Platform>, or build/Steam/<Product> for a multi-platform build)

commands.name: symbols
commands.description: Upload debug symbols (PDBs) to the Sentry crash server

arguments.name: paths
arguments.description: Files or directories to scan for debug files (default: Engine/Binaries/<platform>/<config>)

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration whose folder to upload symbols from (default: every folder in Engine/Binaries/<platform>): debug | dev | profile | release | debuggame

options.name: --url
options.description: Sentry server URL (default: SENTRY_URL or https://sentry.mowo.work)

options.name: --org
options.description: Organization slug (default: SENTRY_ORG or mowo-group)

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug (default: SENTRY_PROJECT or mowo-engine)

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the server to fully process uploaded files

commands.name: workshop-upload
commands.description: Upload a packaged mod to the Steam Workshop (writes the item VDF, then runs steamcmd)

options.name: --mod
options.description: Packaged mod folder (the output of `mbt package-mod`)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: The game's Steam app id

options.name: --item-id
options.description: Existing Workshop item to update (default: the manifest's workshopId; 0 creates a new item)

options.name: --preview
options.description: Preview image (default: preview.png in the mod folder)

options.name: --change-note
options.description: Change note shown on the item

options.name: --visibility
options.description: 0 public, 1 friends only, 2 private (default), 3 unlisted

options.name: --username
options.description: Steam account (default: MOWO_STEAM_USER); log in once with `steamcmd +login <user>` so it caches credentials

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Write the VDF and stop — steamcmd is never invoked

options.name: --out
options.description: Where the VDF goes (default: <mod>/../Workshop)
